name: Gets a list of company_gateways
description:
Lists company_gateways, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.

        Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the company_gateways, these are handled by the CompanyGatewayFilters class which defines the methods available
whenToUse: List or filter many configured company payment gateways with pagination and sorting; reach for it to browse all gateways, not one by id.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description:
Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column|asc` or `column|desc`.

*Single sort** — for example `sort=label|asc`.

*Multiple sorts** — for example
`sort[]=id|desc&sort[]=label|asc`.

Sorting is limited to columns on the company gateways table (for example `label`, `id`). Unsupported keys are ignored.
